title: Emergency call and warning message errors
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on emergency call system malfunction alerts alongside a few other vehicle or app error messages, with many fragments lacking enough context to determine sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe emergency call system malfunction or unavailable warnings, repeated alert chimes, and other malfunction messages such as back seat restraint issues.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention assorted error messages such as towing-required drivetrain or driveability alerts, eSIM reader disconnection, key-needed notices, and app panic button unavailability without enough context to judge sentiment.

limitations: The topic mixes emergency call system alerts with unrelated warning messages such as drivetrain, key, restraint, and app feature notices.
Several fragments are brief status reports without enough detail to determine customer sentiment or outcome.
The examples are limited to G70 reviews from the US, so the summary should not be generalized beyond this sample.
